sources.title: Ateneo de Naga University: History
sources.note: Supports the facts listed here; historical events do not date the current mapped geometry.

text.en: The Jesuits founded Ateneo de Naga as a boys' school in 1940 at Bishop Pedro P. Santos's invitation.
Japanese forces occupied the campus and used it as a prison during World War II.
The college opened on June 5, 1947 with 87 male students.
The college became coeducational in 1953 when five women enrolled.
